# g15 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 3
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 10 for i = 1, 2, 3

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = 1000 - \frac{1}{0.1 + \sum_{i=1}^3 x_i^2} - \frac{1}{0.1 + \sum_{i=1}^3 (x_i - 1)^2}
```

### Constraints
```math
h_1(x) = \sum_{i=1}^3 x_i^2 - 0.6 = 0
```
```math
h_2(x) = \sum_{i=1}^3 (x_i - 1)^2 - 0.6 = 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = 961.715022
